tasks.name: Support ticket triage
tasks.baseline_prompt: You are a support assistant. Please read the following support ticket carefully and classify it. Classify the ticket as billing, bug, or question. Explain your reasoning briefly. Thanks!

examples.input: My card was charged twice this month.
examples.expected: billing

examples.input: The export button does nothing on Safari.
examples.expected: bug

examples.input: Do you support SAML single sign-on?
examples.expected: question

examples.input: I was billed after cancelling my plan.
examples.expected: billing

examples.input: Dashboard shows a blank chart after the update.
examples.expected: bug

examples.input: How many seats come with the team plan?
examples.expected: question

examples.input: Refund still has not arrived after two weeks.
examples.expected: billing

examples.input: App crashes when I upload a 40MB file.
examples.expected: bug

examples.input: Can I change my invoice address?
examples.expected: question

examples.input: Charged in USD but my account is in EUR.
examples.expected: billing

tasks.name: Support ticket summary
tasks.baseline_prompt: Please could you summarize the support ticket below for me. I would like a summary of the ticket below. Thanks in advance!

examples.input: Customer was double charged in March and is asking for a refund to the original card.
examples.expected: Double charged in March; wants a refund to the original card.

examples.input: Export fails on Safari 17 with a console error; works in Chrome.
examples.expected: Export broken on Safari 17, works in Chrome.

examples.input: Team of 12 wants SAML SSO before renewing in January.
examples.expected: Team of 12 needs SAML SSO before a January renewal.

examples.input: Upload of a 40MB CSV crashes the app; smaller files are fine.
examples.expected: 40MB CSV upload crashes the app; smaller files work.

examples.input: Account billed in USD although the workspace region is EUR.
examples.expected: Billed in USD despite an EUR workspace.

examples.input: Refund approved on the 3rd but not received after fourteen days.
examples.expected: Refund approved on the 3rd, still not received after 14 days.

examples.input: Charts render blank after the 4.2 release for users on Firefox.
examples.expected: Blank charts on Firefox since release 4.2.

examples.input: Customer cancelled in June but was charged again in July.
examples.expected: Cancelled in June, charged again in July.

examples.input: Asking whether invoice addresses can be edited after issue.
examples.expected: Wants to know if an issued invoice address can be edited.

examples.input: Seat count question: how many seats are included on the team plan.
examples.expected: Asking how many seats the team plan includes.
